description: Seed gazetteer for deterministic Jakarta administrative-location matching in Waspada Jakarta. Contains province, six administrative city/regency areas, 44 districts, and 267 kelurahan records from the user-supplied table after one ambiguous Koja locality is excluded from the administrative kelurahan list.

reviewWarnings: Counts are a seed-data inspection, not a formal certification of the current legal administrative roster.

The supplied list contains 268 rows, while one Koja row named Rawa Badak appears to be a locality label rather than a separate kelurahan. It is preserved under unverifiedLocalities and is not silently assigned to Rawa Badak Utara or Rawa Badak Selatan.

The source snapshot date and underlying publisher were not included. Reconcile the complete list against the current DKI ArcGIS administrative boundary layer and Perda No. 2 Tahun 2026 before treating it as canonical production data.
No administrative codes or coordinates were supplied. IDs in this file are deterministic application IDs, not official government codes.

Legacy non-administrative terms from the existing RSS JAKARTA_TOPONYMS array are preserved separately under supplementalLegacyLocalities. They are context-only/ambiguous and cannot satisfy the specific administrative location gate.

DET-FILTER-03: jakartaPlaces are name-only curated entries (no coordinates, source curated_name_only). They satisfy the place gate but never the administrative gate. singleTokenAliasBlocklist removes ordinary-word and out-of-DKI homonym bare aliases.

steps: replace punctuation and separators with spaces
matchingPolicy.matchMethod: Exact token-sequence / phrase match with token boundaries; never raw substring includes.
matchingPolicy.overlapPolicy: Prefer the longest, most specific administrative phrase. A matched kelurahan should carry its known district and city parents as hierarchy context; do not count parent names as independent additional matches.
matchingPolicy.singleTokenPolicy: Single-token canonical names (context_required) become specific only with incident co-context AND corroboration of the same record. A single-token kecamatan corroborates itself (its own name is its matching kecamatan). A single-token kelurahan needs its own parent kecamatan (a same-name kecamatan mention counts) or its own kota in the text. A province or other-city hit never corroborates. Single-token aliases listed in singleTokenAliasBlocklist (ordinary words and out-of-DKI homonyms) are indexed only in their prefixed multi-token form (for example Kelurahan Baru), which is then an explicit multi-token form.
broadAliases: Ibu Kota (only when it refers to Jakarta, see contextualAliasGuards)
matchingPolicy.negativePolicy: A location mention in an arrest location, police station, hospital, place of treatment, origin/destination, or article attribution must not automatically be interpreted as incident scene. Return unknown/non-scene role unless clear scene language supports it.
matchingPolicy.supplementalLegacyLocalityPolicy: Only csw remains supplemental (unverified acronym). Every other former supplemental term is now a jakartaPlaces entry: a named DKI road, toll road, landmark, station, terminal or area. Such entries satisfy the Jakarta place gate for candidacy but never the specific administrative location gate and never carry coordinates.
matchingPolicy.jakartaPlacePolicy: jakartaPlaces are named places inside DKI (roads, toll roads, landmarks, stations, terminals, malls, port areas, a few areas). A match is level jakarta_place and strength named_place. It is never a point: no coordinates, no radius and no geometry are derived from it.
matchingPolicy.contextualAliasGuardPolicy: contextualAliasGuards list phrases that are only a Jakarta reference in some contexts (Ibu Kota). The guard checks the following token; a non-listed following token means no province match.
matchingPolicy.homonymGuardPolicy: A jakarta_place match is dropped when an out-of-DKI or foreign cue (outOfDkiHomonymCueTerms for road and toll names; jakartaPlaceHomonymGuards for named records) appears in the text and the text names no DKI kelurahan, kecamatan, city or the province. Road and toll names (Sudirman, Gatot Subroto, Antasari, JORR...) also exist in other cities.

contextualAliasGuards.meaning: Counts as the Jakarta province only when the phrase is not followed by a non-Jakarta name or by Nusantara/IKN/provinsi/kabupaten wording.

supplementalLegacyLocalities.notes: Preserved for compatibility with the repository legacy list. This is not an official administrative record; use only as a weak/ambiguous location signal until independently curated.
